description: Retrieval eval: same intent in en / hi (Devanagari) / hinglish (Roman). A hit is any top-k doc matching ANY relevance rule. Rules: {field: value} where 'topic'/'section'/'doc_type' must equal and 'act' must contain value. Statutory rules (act+section) accept the official Act text in data/legal_corpus; section titles verified against the corpus files.
